chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

If people were to take what Allah commanded them to take and spend it on what He prohibited, He would not accept it from them. And if they were to take what Allah prohibited and spend it on what He commanded, He would not accept it from them until they take it from what is rightful and spend it in what is rightful.

key_terms.أَمَرَهُمُ: what Allah commanded them to do or take
key_terms.حَقٍّ: that which is lawful, rightful, and justly due
key_terms.قَبِلَهُ: accepted it as a valid and pleasing deed
key_terms.يُنْفِقُوهُ: they spend it or disburse it

ai.seo_question: Does Allah accept charity or spending if the wealth was acquired unlawfully?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that deeds are not accepted merely by outward appearance or good intention when the means or the expenditure are unlawful. Acceptance depends on both acquiring wealth lawfully and spending it in a lawful, rightful way.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If people were to take what Allah (swt) commanded them to take and spend it on what He prohibited, He would not accept it from them. And if they were to take what Allah (swt) prohibited and spend it on what He commanded, He would not accept it from them—until they take it lawfully and spend it lawfully."
